dialog.endpointHelp: Enter the MCP HTTP endpoint URL; choose the transport in the main toolbar. Custom headers apply to handshake and all JSON-RPC requests.
dialog.headersNotice: Custom headers & storage: you may add HTTP headers such as <auth/>; they apply to all MCP requests for this endpoint (including session teardown). Where the OS credential store is available, values are encrypted with Electron <ss/> before persisting locally; otherwise they are stored in plain text. Do not store highly sensitive credentials on untrusted devices.
dialog.noHeadersHint: No additional headers. Click “Add row” if you need a Bearer credential.
dialog.errorHttpOnly: Only http and https are supported

tools.selectAddressHint: Choose an endpoint in the sidebar to inspect tools
tools.connectionStatus: Result of the last “refresh tool list” for this endpoint (handshake + tools/list). Not a live online monitor—updates when you refresh or change endpoint/transport.
tools.sessionReuseTitle: This session only; each workspace has its own toggle. When on, tools/list and tools/call reuse one MCP session for this endpoint in the current workspace (fewer initialize handshakes). Not saved; defaults to off after each app launch. Cache expires after ~15 minutes idle. Only available with Streamable HTTP; HTTP/SSE requires a dedicated SSE connection and does not use this option.
tools.sseLinkTitle: HTTP/SSE: after a successful tools/list refresh, one long-lived connection is kept; later tools/call uses the same link. Idle ~15 minutes may drop it. Changing endpoint, transport, or failures closes it—refresh the list again.
tools.sseNotHeld: Refresh the tool list for this endpoint first to establish and keep the HTTP/SSE connection before calling tools.

tools.httpNoResponse: No HTTP response (e.g. network error or timeout). The request below is what was sent.

tools.mcpHeaderNameInvalid: Row {{row}}: the header name contains non-Latin-1 characters (e.g. CJK). Electron/Chromium cannot build this HTTP header locally. Use ASCII-only names (e.g. Authorization, X-Api-Key).
tools.mcpHeaderValueInvalid: The value of header "{{name}}" contains non-Latin-1 characters (e.g. CJK). Use only letters, digits, and common symbols, or encode payload as Base64 (ASCII-only).
tools.argsRootObject: Top level must be a JSON object, e.g. {} or {"key":"value"}

usageGuide.title: User guide
usageGuide.content:
Add and select an MCP (HTTP) endpoint in the sidebar to fetch the tools list per the protocol and inspect each tool’s description and input schema (inputSchema). The main toolbar lets you switch between Streamable HTTP and HTTP/SSE remote transport.

Use File → Export/Import MCP endpoint configuration JSON for migration or backup.

Appearance and other system-wide options are under the Settings menu.
